author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
Sweet cherries, warm sunshine, and a timeless village tradition 🍒🌿 In this video, we harvest fresh cherries and turn them into homemade Pastila — a naturally sweet fruit treat made using a traditional preservation method.

The cherries are slowly cooked into a rich, flavorful puree, then carefully dried to create soft, chewy sheets packed with natural fruit flavor. With no unnecessary ingredients, this simple recipe is a delicious way to preserve the taste of summer for the months ahead.

Making fruit Pastila is a cherished countryside tradition that transforms seasonal fruit into a wholesome homemade treat. It's a simple, natural way to enjoy the sweetness of fresh cherries long after the harvest season has ended. 🍒✨
title: Cherry Harvest Season – Preserving Summer for Winter 🍒🌿
